blocks.html: Speak to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree. He will give you a gnome royal seal.
blocks.text: Speak to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree. He will give you a gnome royal seal.

blocks.html: Right-click the ladder, select Top Floor, and take the glider from Captain Errdo to Karamja - 'Gandius'.
blocks.text: Right-click the ladder, select Top Floor, and take the glider from Captain Errdo to Karamja - 'Gandius'.

blocks.html: Head north along the coast to reach the shipyard and try to enter through the gate.
blocks.text: Head north along the coast to reach the shipyard and try to enter through the gate.

blocks.html: Speak with G.L.O. Caranock in the hut southeast of the gate.
blocks.text: Speak with G.L.O. Caranock in the hut southeast of the gate.

blocks.html: Return to King Narnode. He gives you Narnode's orders.

substeps.html: You can return to Captain Klemfoodle to take the glider to The Grand Tree - 'Ta Quir Priw'

blocks.html: Talk to Daero, found on the east side of the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US) of the Grand Tree. He is at the Blurberry bar platform.
blocks.text: Talk to Daero, found on the east side of the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US) of the Grand Tree. He is at the Blurberry bar platform.

blocks.html: Talk to Daero.
blocks.text: Talk to Daero.

blocks.html: Begin the puzzle by clicking on the Reinitialisation Panel to the south-east in front of the long pipe.
blocks.text: Begin the puzzle by clicking on the Reinitialisation Panel to the south-east in front of the long pipe.

blocks.html: Unscramble the puzzle. Caution: The A3 and A5 pieces look near identical and can make the solving the puzzle difficult (A3 should have a straight cloud bottom on the tile and A5 should have a small curve at the bottom right corner of the tile).
blocks.text: Unscramble the puzzle. Caution: The A3 and A5 pieces look near identical and can make the solving the puzzle difficult (A3 should have a straight cloud bottom on the tile and A5 should have a small curve at the bottom right corner of the tile).

substeps.html: You can use this sliding puzzle solver.
substeps.text: You can use this sliding puzzle solver.

substeps.html: Or pay Glough 200,000 coins. He's located in the tree house south-east of the Grand Tree. Speak to Daero at the Blurberry bar platform to return to the hangar; you will only have to complete the last move in the puzzle if you pay.
substeps.text: Or pay Glough 200,000 coins. He's located in the tree house south-east of the Grand Tree. Speak to Daero at the Blurberry bar platform to return to the hangar; you will only have to complete the last move in the puzzle if you pay.

blocks.html: There is a cutscene when the puzzle is correct. Speak to Daero and then to Waydar to fly to Crash Island.
blocks.text: There is a cutscene when the puzzle is correct. Speak to Daero and then to Waydar to fly to Crash Island.

blocks.html: Speak to Lumdo.
blocks.text: Speak to Lumdo.

blocks.html: Speak to Waydar who will convince Lumdo to follow orders.
blocks.text: Speak to Waydar who will convince Lumdo to follow orders.

options.text: I cannot convince Lumdo to take us to the island…

blocks.html: Recommended: turn off auto-retaliate and leave it off until the final battle (Can be toggled on/off by clicking the button left of the adrenaline gauge on the Action Bar).
blocks.text: Recommended: turn off auto-retaliate and leave it off until the final battle (Can be toggled on/off by clicking the button left of the adrenaline gauge on the Action Bar).

blocks.html: On the island, travel west then north to a bamboo gate. Stand there getting pelted by poisoned arrows until you are brought to a prison. You will take some damage and be poisoned.
blocks.text: On the island, travel west then north to a bamboo gate. Stand there getting pelted by poisoned arrows until you are brought to a prison. You will take some damage and be poisoned.

blocks.html: Picklock the cell when there is no guard outside and escape the prison.
blocks.text: Picklock the cell when there is no guard outside and escape the prison.

substeps.html: Stay at least 2 squares away from the guards (even while in the cell) otherwise they will attack and damage you.
substeps.text: Stay at least 2 squares away from the guards (even while in the cell) otherwise they will attack and damage you.

blocks.html: Stay in the grass to hide from archer monkeys and travel south against the western wall of the Temple of Marimbo.
blocks.text: Stay in the grass to hide from archer monkeys and travel south against the western wall of the Temple of Marimbo.

blocks.html: Go east along the wall of the temple and around the monkey palace. Speak to Garkor.
blocks.text: Go east along the wall of the temple and around the monkey palace. Speak to Garkor.

blocks.caption: The location of the crate that holds the monkeyspeak amulet moulds.

blocks.html: Head to the U-shaped building in the southern side of the monkey village. Enter through the southern door otherwise you will be knocked out.
blocks.text: Head to the U-shaped building in the southern side of the monkey village. Enter through the southern door otherwise you will be knocked out.

substeps.html: Stay on the dark brown ground at the perimeter of the room.
substeps.text: Stay on the dark brown ground at the perimeter of the room.

blocks.html: Search the stacked crates two tiles east of the trapdoor for monkey dentures (you can grab another for making a tooth creature).
blocks.text: Search the stacked crates two tiles east of the trapdoor for monkey dentures (you can grab another for making a tooth creature).

blocks.html: Search the south-easternmost crate (which is a different style and slightly darker brown) to crawl down into the basement - you may fall and take up to 50% of your life points in damage.
blocks.text: Search the south-easternmost crate (which is a different style and slightly darker brown) to crawl down into the basement - you may fall and take up to 50% of your life points in damage.

blocks.html: In the northwest corner there's a cluster of crates around a stalagmite; search the crate directly south of the stalagmite for a monkeyspeak amulet mould.
blocks.text: In the northwest corner there's a cluster of crates around a stalagmite; search the crate directly south of the stalagmite for a monkeyspeak amulet mould.

blocks.html: If you needed to leave to obtain items, teleport to Al Kharid, go north, talk to Captain Dalbur to glide to the Tree Gnome Stronghold, then talk to Daero at Blurberry's Bar to return to the hangar.
blocks.text: If you needed to leave to obtain items, teleport to Al Kharid, go north, talk to Captain Dalbur to glide to the Tree Gnome Stronghold, then talk to Daero at Blurberry's Bar to return to the hangar.

substeps.html: Protect from Melee is highly recommended here, as are antipoison and energy potions. Make sure to have several pieces of food (and/or Enhanced Excalibur) for healing from the traps and mobs.

blocks.html: At the end of the dungeon (the most north-eastern part), speak to Zooknock first.
blocks.text: At the end of the dungeon (the most north-eastern part), speak to Zooknock first.

blocks.html: Use the gold bar on Zooknock.
blocks.text: Use the gold bar on Zooknock.

blocks.html: Use the monkey dentures on Zooknock.
blocks.text: Use the monkey dentures on Zooknock.

blocks.html: Use the monkeyspeak amulet mould on Zooknock. He will give you an enchanted bar and your mould back.
blocks.text: Use the monkeyspeak amulet mould on Zooknock. He will give you an enchanted bar and your mould back.

blocks.html: Use the bones on Zooknock if you already have them.
blocks.text: Use the bones on Zooknock if you already have them.

substeps.html: If you use the monkey bones on him here, you don't need to get new ones when turning in the talisman. Monkey bones from the monkey zombies in the cave do not work. Keep your monkeyspeak amulet mould as it used in Do No Evil.
substeps.text: If you use the monkey bones on him here, you don't need to get new ones when turning in the talisman. Monkey bones from the monkey zombies in the cave do not work. Keep your monkeyspeak amulet mould as it used in Do No Evil.

substeps.html: Make sure you finish the dialogue after giving him the three items and the bones; otherwise, you will not receive the enchanted bar and your mould back. If you leave the area, you will have to run all the way back through this cave to finish the dialogue to get the enchanted gold bar.

blocks.html: Return to Marim (Ape Atoll) (protect from missiles and surge to gate).
blocks.text: Return to Marim (Ape Atoll) (protect from missiles and surge to gate).

blocks.html: Escape prison and run east into the temple.
blocks.text: Escape prison and run east into the temple.

blocks.html: Take the southern ladder up, the eastern ladder down, and then the trapdoor down into the dungeon.
blocks.text: Take the southern ladder up, the eastern ladder down, and then the trapdoor down into the dungeon.

substeps.html: Alternatively, you can kill one of the two gorilla guards blocking the trapdoor and climb down that way.
substeps.text: Alternatively, you can kill one of the two gorilla guards blocking the trapdoor and climb down that way.

blocks.html: Use the enchanted bar on a pillar of fire and use the amulet on a ball of wool to create an monkeyspeak amulet.
blocks.text: Use the enchanted bar on a pillar of fire and use the amulet on a ball of wool to create an monkeyspeak amulet.

blocks.html: Go to the banana garden west of the prison.
blocks.text: Go to the banana garden west of the prison.

blocks.html: Wait for the monkey's aunt to leave and quickly go into the garden through the corridor at its north-east corner.
blocks.text: Wait for the monkey's aunt to leave and quickly go into the garden through the corridor at its north-east corner.

blocks.html: When she returns, run back into the corridor.
blocks.text: When she returns, run back into the corridor.

substeps.html: You can stay in the area with red monkey knife fighters if the guards are called and climb the ladder to the south up and back down again.
substeps.text: You can stay in the area with red monkey knife fighters if the guards are called and climb the ladder to the south up and back down again.

blocks.html: Equip the monkeyspeak amulet, talk to the monkey child, and talk to him again.
blocks.text: Equip the monkeyspeak amulet, talk to the monkey child, and talk to him again.

options.text: Well I’ll be a monkey’s uncle!

blocks.html: Talk to Monkey child again.
blocks.text: Talk to Monkey child again.

options.text: How many bananas did Aunty want?

blocks.html: You will have to wait for The Monkey's Aunt to pass by the child once again before the child gives you the Monkey talisman.
blocks.text: You will have to wait for The Monkey's Aunt to pass by the child once again before the child gives you the Monkey talisman.

blocks.html: Take your monkey bones and monkey talisman and use it on Zooknock at the end of the dungeon under Ape Atoll.
blocks.text: Take your monkey bones and monkey talisman and use it on Zooknock at the end of the dungeon under Ape Atoll.

substeps.html: Make sure to make the standard monkey greegree for the next steps as other forms will not work.

substeps.html: Bring other monkey bones and multiple talismans if you want to make more greegrees and then use your Monkey talisman and different types of monkey bones on Zooknock.
substeps.text: Bring other monkey bones and multiple talismans if you want to make more greegrees and then use your Monkey talisman and different types of monkey bones on Zooknock.

blocks.html: During this section, do not teleport while you're carrying the monkey or you will have to re-obtain the monkey. This includes spirit tree teleportation.

blocks.html: Enter Ardougne Zoo and equip your greegree near the monkey zone. Speak to the monkey minder.
blocks.text: Enter Ardougne Zoo and equip your greegree near the monkey zone. Speak to the monkey minder.

substeps.html: If you have other monkeys types on your monkey greegree, make sure to swap it to the Karamjan monkey (brown with red cap). Otherwise the monkey minder will say to you that you aren't getting anywhere near his monkeys.
substeps.text: If you have other monkeys types on your monkey greegree, make sure to swap it to the Karamjan monkey (brown with red cap). Otherwise the monkey minder will say to you that you aren't getting anywhere near his monkeys.

blocks.text: Talk to the elder guard west of Garkor, they will say you need permission from Kruk.

substeps.html: Prayer flicking between Protect from Melee and Magic (or Deflect Melee and Magic) can prevent most damage. Begin on Protect From Melee, and as the demon begins the animation for the magic attack swap to Protect from Magic, then wait for the hit and switch back to Protect from Melee. Otherwise, remain on Protect from or Deflect Magic.
